description: Default capability: the app's own webview may invoke the engine-bridge commands, listen to shell events, and read the app's name/version, and nothing else. Matched on `webviews: ["main"]`, NOT `windows: ["main"]` — the main window hosts untrusted child webviews (browser-*) alongside the UI's own, and a child reports its parent's window label; a window-matched grant would be inherited by every page seated in the window and hand the whole `codify_*` surface to untrusted content. Grants only the minimal core permissions the UI actually uses instead of `core:default`, plus the `shell` permission set (src-tauri/permissions/shell.json) which names every `codify_*` command one by one.
